description:
Always `200` for a known id owned by the caller; a non-terminal state is a status, not an
error. An unknown id, or one owned by another tenant, is `404`. While `status` is
non-terminal the response carries `Retry-After`. When `succeeded`, `result` is embedded
in this response (there is no redirect to a second resource). When `failed`, `error` is
the surface's `Error` shape with a snake_case code. When `canceled`, `canceled_reason`
says why. The resource is retained for **7 days after it reaches a terminal state**;
`expires_at` says when, and the response carries a matching `Expires` header. After that
the id is **`410 Gone`** (`generation_expired`), distinct from `404` for an id that never
existed or is not yours.
name: get_message_generation
title: Get message generation
